english.note: Use this for an exclamation caused specifically by surprise or alarm, especially in more formal or written contexts.

examples.english: As the fire suddenly spread, everyone could not help but exclaim, “Get out quickly!”
examples.traditional: 火勢突然蔓延，眾人不禁驚呼：「快啲離開！」
